description: Create or update up to 500 evidence tracking records in one transaction (write — editor role). Each upserts by evidence_id; only fields given change. Use instead of 500 scf_update_evidence calls.

operations.description: Upsert operations, max 500 — each keyed by evidence_id

assigned_user_id.description: User responsible for collecting — becomes assignee on generated tasks; must be in the owning team

collecting_system.description: Name of the tool or system that collects the evidence

comments.description: Free-text notes on this evidence item

is_tracked.description: Toggle active tracking for this item

owner_user_id.description: User accountable for this evidence — task assignee when assigned_user_id is unset

system_id.description: System that collects this evidence — obtain from scf_list_systems

name: scf_batch_update_evidence
